name: SAI LIFE SCIENCES LIMITED
summary: Sai Life Sciences Limited operates as a contract research, development, and manufacturing organization (CRDMO) in India and internationally. It provides medicinal chemistry, pharmacokinetics, manufacturing, and contract development services. The company was formerly known as SAI Advantium Pharma Limited and changed its name to Sai Life Sciences Limited in July 2006. Sai Life Sciences Limited was incorporated in 1999 and is based in Hyderabad, India.
